# openwebui_skill (Data Source)

Looks up an existing skill by its `skill_id` or by its (instance-unique) `name`. Exactly one of the two must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by name (skill names are unique)...
data "openwebui_skill" "by_name" {
  name = "Customer Support Playbook"
}

# ...or by identifier.
data "openwebui_skill" "by_id" {
  skill_id = "customer-support-playbook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the skill to look up (skill names are unique). Conflicts with `skill_id`.
- `skill_id` (String) Identifier of the skill to look up. Conflicts with `name`.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Instruction text of the skill.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of creation.
- `description` (String) Short description of the skill.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the skill as stored by Open WebUI. Equal to `skill_id`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the skill is enabled.
- `read_groups` (List of String) Read-access group names currently applied to this skill.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags assigned to the skill.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of last update.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier.
- `write_access` (Boolean) Whether the authenticated user has write access.
- `write_groups` (List of String) Write-access group names currently applied to this skill.
